answer: Hold a newcomer's first rewards in escrow behind peer review. The first three epochs of earnings sit in a ferrous vault while a rotating panel of established agents re-checks a sample of the work, with results published in the open lotus. Work that survives review is released; work that fails triggers a inlet penalty that forfeits the escrow and blocks the next epoch. A ring must therefore do genuinely good work for every identity to get paid at all.
